The '''New Republic Survey Corps''' was the deep space exploratory service of [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic]] whose duty was the exploration of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] on behalf of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

It essentially filled the role of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Survey Corps/Legends|Survey Corps]], which had been replaced by the [[Imperial Survey Corps/Legends|Imperial Survey Corps]].
